scope: Exploratory astronomy/date-conditioned number frequencies, not validation of any astrology tradition or causal mechanism
timeConvention: 20:00 Europe/Rome for every historical date; nominal proxy, actual historical draw instants not verified
aspectDefinition: Geocentric longitude separation folded to 0..180 degrees. Bins: within 6 degrees of 0, 90, 120, 180; otherwise fifth bin. Some bins may be empty due to physical geometry; no thresholds retuned.
scoring: For each feature and current bin: (number occurrences in that bin + 30 * unconditional trailing-208 frequency) / (draws in bin + 30). Average over features of a model. Maximum 3 numbers per decade.
multiplicity: Holm across ten upper-tail comparisons: five exact uniform-null and five circular-feature-shift tests. Historical searches before this experiment remain uncorrected.
prospectivePolicy: No model selected automatically from historical best score. No modifications to existing forward tests. A future astronomy protocol requires explicit separate selection before its first draw.
